# Appendix {.appendix}

| Component | Input dimension | Output dimension | Activation |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Numeric input | $n_{\text{features}}$ | $n_{\text{features}}$ | -- |
| Hidden layer 1 | $n_{\text{features}}$ | 64 | ReLU |
| Hidden layer 2 | 64 | 32 | ReLU |
| Numeric output | 32 | 1 | Linear |
| Spatial bias | Spatial-unit ID | 1 | -- |
| Combination | Numeric score + spatial bias | 1 | Addition |
| Final output | 1 | 1 | Softplus |

: Architecture of the neural-network baseline {#tbl-nn-baseline-architecture}

The spatial bias is implemented as a one-dimensional embedding. It represents an
additive spatial intercept rather than a multidimensional representation-learning
embedding. Index zero is reserved for spatial units not observed in the training
split and has no learned effect.

## Neural-network baseline training configuration {#sec-nn-baseline-training}

| Setting | Configuration |
|---|---|
| Datasets | H3 resolution 7, census tracts, and filtered community areas |
| Temporal units | 1h, 4h, and 24h |
| Number of models | 9 |
| Training objective | Mean squared error (MSE) |
| Optimizer | Adam |
| Learning rate | 0.001 |
| Batch size | 1,024 |
| Maximum epochs | 100 |
| Early-stopping patience | 10 epochs |
| Minimum improvement | 0 |
| Checkpoint-selection metric | Validation MAE |
| Output constraint | Softplus activation |
| Numerical preprocessing | StandardScaler fitted exclusively on TRAIN |
| Spatial preprocessing | Categorical mapping fitted exclusively on TRAIN |
| Reproducibility | Dataset-specific seed, starting at 42 |
| Model development split | TRAIN for fitting and VAL for model selection |
| Final evaluation split | TEST remains unused during model development |

: Training configuration of the neural-network baseline {#tbl-nn-baseline-training}

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

results_path = Path(
    "models/full/baseline_NN_spatial_bias_v1_validation_results.parquet"
)
if not results_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing baseline results: {results_path}. "
        "Run the NN-baseline notebook in Full Mode before rendering the report."
    )

baseline_results = (
    pd.read_parquet(
        results_path,
        columns=[
            "model_tag",
            "nn_val_mae",
            "zero_val_mae",
            "global_median_val_mae",
            "spatial_time_weekday_mean_val_mae",
            "nn_val_mae_skill_score",
        ],
    )
    .assign(
        skill_vs_zero=lambda frame: (
            1 - frame["nn_val_mae"] / frame["zero_val_mae"]
        ),
        skill_vs_global_median=lambda frame: (
            1
            - frame["nn_val_mae"]
            / frame["global_median_val_mae"]
        ),
    )
    .sort_values("nn_val_mae_skill_score", ascending=False)
    .rename(
        columns={
            "model_tag": "Model",
            "nn_val_mae": "NN MAE",
            "spatial_time_weekday_mean_val_mae": "S×T×W MAE",
            "skill_vs_zero": "Skill: zero",
            "skill_vs_global_median": "Skill: median",
            "nn_val_mae_skill_score": "Skill: S×T×W",
        }
    )
    [
        [
            "Model",
            "NN MAE",
            "S×T×W MAE",
            "Skill: zero",
            "Skill: median",
            "Skill: S×T×W",
        ]
    ]
    .round(4)
)

baseline_results
```

## Neural-network baseline diagnostics {#sec-nn-baseline-diagnostics}

```{python}
#| label: setup-nn-baseline-diagnostics
#| include: false

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, TensorDataset

baseline_checkpoint_path = Path(
    "models/full/"
    "baseline_NN_spatial_bias_v1_census_tracts_1h_best_model.pt"
)
baseline_validation_path = Path(
    "data/full/train_test_data/"
    "GOLD_1H_DEMAND_CENSUS_TRACTS_VAL.parquet"
)
for required_path in (baseline_checkpoint_path, baseline_validation_path):
    if not required_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing baseline diagnostic input: {required_path}")

baseline_checkpoint = torch.load(
    baseline_checkpoint_path,
    map_location="cpu",
    weights_only=False,
)


class AppendixBaselineNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, num_spatial_units):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(64, 32),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(32, 1),
        )
        self.spatial_bias = nn.Embedding(
            num_embeddings=num_spatial_units + 1,
            embedding_dim=1,
            padding_idx=0,
        )
        self.output_activation = nn.Softplus()

    def forward(self, x, spatial_idx):
        return self.output_activation(
            self.network(x) + self.spatial_bias(spatial_idx)
        )


baseline_model = AppendixBaselineNN(
    **baseline_checkpoint["model_kwargs"]
)
baseline_model.load_state_dict(baseline_checkpoint["model_state_dict"])
baseline_model.eval()

baseline_val_df = pl.read_parquet(
    baseline_validation_path,
    columns=[
        *baseline_checkpoint["feature_cols"],
        baseline_checkpoint["spatial_col"],
        "trip_count",
    ],
)
baseline_features = baseline_val_df.select(
    baseline_checkpoint["feature_cols"]
).to_numpy()
baseline_features = (
    (
        baseline_features
        - np.asarray(baseline_checkpoint["scaler_mean"])
    )
    / np.asarray(baseline_checkpoint["scaler_scale"])
).astype("float32")
baseline_spatial_indices = (
    baseline_val_df
    .select(
        pl.col(baseline_checkpoint["spatial_col"])
        .cast(pl.String)
        .replace_strict(
            baseline_checkpoint["spatial_to_idx"],
            default=0,
        )
        .cast(pl.Int64)
    )
    .to_series()
    .to_numpy()
)
baseline_y_true = baseline_val_df["trip_count"].to_numpy().astype("float32")

baseline_loader = DataLoader(
    TensorDataset(
        torch.tensor(baseline_features),
        torch.tensor(baseline_spatial_indices, dtype=torch.long),
    ),
    batch_size=baseline_checkpoint["batch_size"],
    shuffle=False,
)
baseline_prediction_parts = []
with torch.inference_mode():
    for feature_batch, spatial_batch in baseline_loader:
        baseline_prediction_parts.append(
            baseline_model(feature_batch, spatial_batch)
            .numpy()
            .reshape(-1)
        )
baseline_y_pred = np.concatenate(baseline_prediction_parts)
if baseline_y_pred.size != baseline_y_true.size:
    raise ValueError("Baseline prediction and validation target counts differ")

baseline_abs_error = np.abs(baseline_y_true - baseline_y_pred)
baseline_bucket_labels = np.select(
    [
        baseline_y_true == 0,
        baseline_y_true <= 1,
        baseline_y_true <= 3,
        baseline_y_true <= 5,
        baseline_y_true <= 10,
        baseline_y_true <= 20,
    ],
    ["0", "1", "2-3", "4-5", "6-10", "11-20"],
    default=">20",
)
baseline_bucket_order = ["0", "1", "2-3", "4-5", "6-10", "11-20", ">20"]
baseline_bucket_metrics = (
    pl.DataFrame(
        {
            "demand_bucket": baseline_bucket_labels,
            "y_true": baseline_y_true,
            "abs_error": baseline_abs_error,
        }
    )
    .group_by("demand_bucket")
    .agg(
        pl.col("abs_error").mean().alias("mae"),
        pl.col("y_true").mean().alias("avg_y_true"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("demand_bucket")
        .replace(
            {
                label: index
                for index, label in enumerate(baseline_bucket_order)
            }
        )
        .cast(pl.Int64)
        .alias("bucket_order")
    )
    .sort("bucket_order")
)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-nn-baseline-diagnostics
#| fig-cap: "Validation diagnostics of the census-tract 1h neural-network baseline: actual versus predicted demand (left), and MAE and average actual demand by demand bucket (right)"
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

sample_size = min(100_000, baseline_y_true.size)
sample_rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
sample_indices = sample_rng.choice(
    baseline_y_true.size,
    size=sample_size,
    replace=False,
)
sample_y_true = baseline_y_true[sample_indices]
sample_y_pred = baseline_y_pred[sample_indices]
axis_maximum = 175

bucket_names = baseline_bucket_metrics["demand_bucket"].to_list()
bucket_positions = np.arange(len(bucket_names))
bar_width = 0.38

figure, axes = plt.subplots(
    1,
    2,
    figsize=(11.5, 4.6),
    constrained_layout=True,
)

scatter_axis = axes[0]
scatter_axis.scatter(
    sample_y_true,
    sample_y_pred,
    alpha=0.18,
    s=6,
)
scatter_axis.plot(
    [0, axis_maximum],
    [0, axis_maximum],
    color="black",
    linestyle="--",
    label="Perfect prediction",
)
scatter_axis.set(
    title="Actual vs. predicted demand",
    xlabel="Actual demand ($y_{true}$)",
    ylabel="Predicted demand ($y_{pred}$)",
    xlim=(0, axis_maximum),
    ylim=(0, axis_maximum),
)
scatter_axis.grid(alpha=0.25)
scatter_axis.legend()

bucket_axis = axes[1]
bucket_axis.bar(
    bucket_positions - bar_width / 2,
    baseline_bucket_metrics["mae"].to_numpy(),
    width=bar_width,
    label="MAE",
)
bucket_axis.bar(
    bucket_positions + bar_width / 2,
    baseline_bucket_metrics["avg_y_true"].to_numpy(),
    width=bar_width,
    label="Average $y_{true}$",
)
bucket_axis.set(
    title="Performance by demand bucket",
    xlabel="Demand bucket",
    ylabel="Trips",
    xticks=bucket_positions,
    xticklabels=bucket_names,
)
bucket_axis.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
bucket_axis.legend()

plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-nn-baseline-all-training-histories
#| fig-cap: "Validation-MAE histories of all nine neural-network baseline models. Columns represent the temporal aggregation and rows the spatial unit; black markers identify the selected checkpoint epochs."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import polars as pl

baseline_history_directory = Path("models/full")
spatial_history_rows = [
    ("H3 resolution 7", "hexagon_h3r7"),
    ("Census tracts", "census_tracts"),
    ("Community areas", "community_areas"),
]
time_history_columns = ["1h", "4h", "24h"]

figure, axes = plt.subplots(
    3,
    3,
    figsize=(12, 8.8),
    sharex=True,
    constrained_layout=True,
)

for row_index, (spatial_label, model_prefix) in enumerate(
    spatial_history_rows
):
    for column_index, time_unit in enumerate(time_history_columns):
        model_tag = f"{model_prefix}_{time_unit}"
        history_path = (
            baseline_history_directory
            / (
                "baseline_NN_spatial_bias_v1_"
                f"{model_tag}_training_history.parquet"
            )
        )
        if not history_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Missing baseline training history: {history_path}"
            )

        model_history = pl.read_parquet(history_path).sort("epoch")
        best_history_epoch = (
            model_history.sort("val_mae").row(0, named=True)
        )
        axis = axes[row_index, column_index]
        axis.plot(
            model_history["epoch"],
            model_history["val_mae"],
            color="tab:blue",
            label="Validation MAE",
        )
        axis.scatter(
            best_history_epoch["epoch"],
            best_history_epoch["val_mae"],
            color="black",
            s=24,
            zorder=3,
        )
        label_on_left = (
            best_history_epoch["epoch"]
            >= 0.8 * model_history["epoch"].max()
        )
        axis.annotate(
            f"Epoch {int(best_history_epoch['epoch'])}",
            (
                best_history_epoch["epoch"],
                best_history_epoch["val_mae"],
            ),
            xytext=(-5 if label_on_left else 5, 6),
            textcoords="offset points",
            fontsize=8,
            horizontalalignment="right" if label_on_left else "left",
        )
        axis.grid(alpha=0.25)

        if row_index == 0:
            axis.set_title(time_unit)
        if column_index == 0:
            axis.set_ylabel(f"{spatial_label}\nValidation MAE")
        if row_index == len(spatial_history_rows) - 1:
            axis.set_xlabel("Epoch")

plt.show()
```

```{python}

from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

final_test_results_path = Path(
    "models/full/nn_final/final_nn_v1_test_results.parquet"
)
if not final_test_results_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing final test results: {final_test_results_path}. "
        "Run the final NN notebook before rendering the report."
    )

census_tract_test_result = (
    pd.read_parquet(final_test_results_path)
    .loc[lambda frame: frame["model_tag"].eq("census_tracts_1h")]
)
if len(census_tract_test_result) != 1:
    raise ValueError(
        "Expected exactly one final test-result row for census_tracts_1h"
    )

    1

    / census_tract_test_result["zero_test_mae"]

    1
    - census_tract_test_result["nn_test_mae"]
    / census_tract_test_result["global_median_test_mae"]
)

        ("Balanced MAE", census_tract_test_result["nn_test_balanced_mae"]),
        ("MAE Skill Score vs. zero", skill_vs_zero),
        (
            "MAE Skill Score vs. global median",
            skill_vs_global_median,
        ),
        (
            "MAE Skill Score vs. spatial × time × weekday",
            census_tract_test_result["nn_test_mae_skill_score"],
        ),
        (
            "Demand precision",
            census_tract_test_result["test_demand_precision"],
        ),
        (
            "Demand recall",
            census_tract_test_result["test_demand_recall"],
        ),
    ],
    columns=["Metric", "Value"],
)
census_tract_test_scores["Value"] = (
    census_tract_test_scores["Value"].map(lambda value: f"{value:.4f}")
)

header = "| Metric | Value |"
separator = "|---|---:|"

    f"| {metric} | {value} |"
    for metric, value in census_tract_test_scores.itertuples(
        index=False,
        name=None,
    )
]
display(Markdown("\n".join([header, separator, *rows])))
```

## Final model test MAE by spatial unit {#sec-final-spatial-unit-test-mae}

```{python}
#| label: fig-final-census-tract-test-mae
#| fig-cap: "Test MAE of the final 1h models by spatial unit. All panels use the same nonlinear color scale and value range; the color-bar values remain MAE in trips per hour."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

from pathlib import Path

import geopandas as gpd
import h3
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
from matplotlib.colors import PowerNorm
import polars as pl
from shapely.geometry import Polygon

final_model_directory = Path("models/full/nn_final")
processed_data_directory = Path("data/full/processed_data")
prediction_paths = {
    "census_tract": (
        final_model_directory
        / "final_nn_v1_census_tracts_1h_test_predictions.parquet"
    ),
    "h3_cell": (
        final_model_directory
        / "final_nn_v1_hexagon_h3r7_1h_test_predictions.parquet"
    ),
    "community_area": (
        final_model_directory
        / "final_nn_v1_community_areas_1h_test_predictions.parquet"
    ),
}
census_tract_geometry_path = (
    processed_data_directory / "silver_census_tracts.geoparquet"
)
community_area_geometry_path = (
    processed_data_directory / "silver_community_areas.geoparquet"
)
for required_path in (
    *prediction_paths.values(),
    census_tract_geometry_path,
    community_area_geometry_path,
):
    if not required_path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Missing spatial MAE map input: {required_path}"
        )

def spatial_test_mae(prediction_path, spatial_column):
    """Aggregate row-level absolute test errors to one MAE per spatial unit."""
    return (
        pl.scan_parquet(prediction_path)
        .group_by(spatial_column)
        .agg(pl.col("abs_error").mean().alias("test_mae"))
        .collect()
        .to_pandas()
    )

census_tract_map = gpd.read_parquet(
    census_tract_geometry_path,
    columns=["CENSUS_T_1", "geometry"],
)
# CENSUS_T_1 contains the complete 11-digit GEOID used in the prediction file.
census_tract_map["census_tract"] = (
    census_tract_map["CENSUS_T_1"].astype("int64")
)
census_tract_map = census_tract_map.merge(
    spatial_test_mae(
        prediction_paths["census_tract"],
        "census_tract",
    ),
    on="census_tract",
    how="left",
    validate="one_to_one",
)

h3_test_mae = spatial_test_mae(
    prediction_paths["h3_cell"],
    "h3_cell",
)
# Convert each H3 cell from the prediction artifact into a polygon. H3 returns
# boundary coordinates as (latitude, longitude), while Shapely expects (x, y).
h3_map = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    h3_test_mae,
    geometry=[
        Polygon(
            [
                (longitude, latitude)
                for latitude, longitude in h3.cell_to_boundary(h3_cell)
            ]
        )
        for h3_cell in h3_test_mae["h3_cell"]
    ],
    crs="EPSG:4326",
)

community_area_map = gpd.read_parquet(
    community_area_geometry_path,
    columns=["AREA_NUMBE", "geometry"],
)
community_area_map["community_area"] = (
    community_area_map["AREA_NUMBE"].astype("int64")
)
community_area_map = community_area_map.merge(
    spatial_test_mae(
        prediction_paths["community_area"],
        "community_area",
    ),
    on="community_area",
    how="left",
    validate="one_to_one",
)

spatial_maps = [
    ("Census tracts", census_tract_map),
    ("H3 resolution 7", h3_map),
    ("Community areas", community_area_map),
]
for spatial_name, spatial_map in spatial_maps:
    if spatial_map["test_mae"].isna().any():
        missing_units = int(spatial_map["test_mae"].isna().sum())
        raise ValueError(
            f"Test MAE is missing for {missing_units} units in {spatial_name}"
        )

# A common normalization makes colors directly comparable across all three
# spatial definitions. The power transformation reveals variation near zero
# without truncating high-error units or changing the values on the color bar.
maximum_test_mae = max(
    float(spatial_map["test_mae"].max())
    for _, spatial_map in spatial_maps
)
color_normalization = PowerNorm(
    gamma=0.35,
    vmin=0,
    vmax=maximum_test_mae,
)

# Use a common map extent so that the three spatial partitions align visually.
minimum_x = min(spatial_map.total_bounds[0] for _, spatial_map in spatial_maps)
minimum_y = min(spatial_map.total_bounds[1] for _, spatial_map in spatial_maps)
maximum_x = max(spatial_map.total_bounds[2] for _, spatial_map in spatial_maps)
maximum_y = max(spatial_map.total_bounds[3] for _, spatial_map in spatial_maps)
x_padding = (maximum_x - minimum_x) * 0.02
y_padding = (maximum_y - minimum_y) * 0.02

figure, axes = plt.subplots(
    1,
    3,
    figsize=(13.5, 5.2),
    constrained_layout=True,
)
for axis, (spatial_name, spatial_map) in zip(axes, spatial_maps):
    spatial_map.plot(
        column="test_mae",
        cmap="YlOrRd",
        norm=color_normalization,
        linewidth=0.18,
        edgecolor="white",
        ax=axis,
    )
    axis.set(
        title=spatial_name,
        xlim=(minimum_x - x_padding, maximum_x + x_padding),
        ylim=(minimum_y - y_padding, maximum_y + y_padding),
    )
    axis.set_axis_off()

color_mapper = ScalarMappable(
    norm=color_normalization,
    cmap="YlOrRd",
)
color_mapper.set_array([])
figure.colorbar(
    color_mapper,
    ax=axes,
    label="Test MAE (trips per hour)",
    fraction=0.025,
    pad=0.02,
    shrink=0.78,
)
plt.show()
```

## Final model skill scores against baselines {#sec-final-skill-baselines}

```{python}
#| label: fig-final-mae-skill-trivial-baselines
#| fig-cap: "Final-model test MAE Skill Scores against the zero, global-median, and spatial × time × weekday baselines. Positive values indicate that the neural network has a lower test MAE than the respective baseline. The broken x-axis preserves the extreme negative score of the unfiltered 24h model while keeping the other scores readable."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

final_test_results_path = Path(
    "models/full/nn_final/final_nn_v1_test_results.parquet"
)
if not final_test_results_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing final test results: {final_test_results_path}. "
        "Run the final NN notebook before rendering the report."
    )

final_skill_scores = pd.read_parquet(
    final_test_results_path,
    columns=[
        "model_tag",
        "nn_test_mae",
        "zero_test_mae",
        "global_median_test_mae",
        "spatial_time_weekday_mean_test_mae",
        "nn_test_mae_skill_score",
    ],
)
reference_mae_columns = [
    "zero_test_mae",
    "global_median_test_mae",
    "spatial_time_weekday_mean_test_mae",
]
if (final_skill_scores[reference_mae_columns] <= 0).any().any():
    raise ValueError(
        "MAE Skill Scores require strictly positive baseline MAEs"
    )

# Use the same order as the existing skill-score plot against the
# spatial × weekday × time baseline in the final NN notebook.
final_skill_scores = final_skill_scores.sort_values(
    "nn_test_mae_skill_score",
)
final_skill_scores["skill_vs_zero"] = (
    1
    - final_skill_scores["nn_test_mae"]
    / final_skill_scores["zero_test_mae"]
)
final_skill_scores["skill_vs_global_median"] = (
    1
    - final_skill_scores["nn_test_mae"]
    / final_skill_scores["global_median_test_mae"]
)
final_skill_scores["skill_vs_spatial_time_weekday"] = (
    1
    - final_skill_scores["nn_test_mae"]
    / final_skill_scores["spatial_time_weekday_mean_test_mae"]
)

dataset_positions = np.arange(len(final_skill_scores))
bar_height = 0.24

figure, (outlier_axis, main_axis) = plt.subplots(
    1,
    2,
    sharey=True,
    figsize=(12, 6.7),
    gridspec_kw={
        "width_ratios": [1, 5],
        "wspace": 0.04,
    },
)
skill_score_series = [
    (
        "skill_vs_zero",
        "Zero baseline",
        "tab:blue",
        -bar_height,
    ),
    (
        "skill_vs_global_median",
        "Global-median baseline",
        "tab:orange",
        0,
    ),
    (
        "skill_vs_spatial_time_weekday",
        "Spatial × time × weekday baseline",
        "tab:green",
        bar_height,
    ),
]
for axis in (outlier_axis, main_axis):
    for column, label, color, offset in skill_score_series:
        axis.barh(
            dataset_positions + offset,
            final_skill_scores[column],
            height=bar_height,
            label=label,
            color=color,
        )
    axis.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.25)

# One spatial-baseline score is around -4.8, whereas all other scores lie
# between roughly -0.65 and 0.75. The split retains the actual linear values
# in both ranges without compressing the remaining bars.
outlier_axis.set_xlim(-5.1, -4.5)
main_axis.set_xlim(-0.75, 0.8)
main_axis.axvline(0, color="black", linewidth=1)
outlier_axis.set(
    ylabel="Dataset",
    yticks=dataset_positions,
    yticklabels=final_skill_scores["model_tag"],
)
main_axis.tick_params(
    axis="y",
    left=False,
    labelleft=False,
)
outlier_axis.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
main_axis.spines["left"].set_visible(False)

# Diagonal marks indicate the omitted interval between the two x-axis ranges.
break_size = 0.012
break_style = {
    "color": "black",
    "clip_on": False,
    "linewidth": 1,
}
outlier_axis.plot(
    (1 - break_size, 1 + break_size),
    (-break_size, break_size),
    transform=outlier_axis.transAxes,
    **break_style,
)
outlier_axis.plot(
    (1 - break_size, 1 + break_size),
    (1 - break_size, 1 + break_size),
    transform=outlier_axis.transAxes,
    **break_style,
)
main_axis.plot(
    (-break_size, break_size),
    (-break_size, break_size),
    transform=main_axis.transAxes,
    **break_style,
)
main_axis.plot(
    (-break_size, break_size),
    (1 - break_size, 1 + break_size),
    transform=main_axis.transAxes,
    **break_style,
)

legend_handles, legend_labels = main_axis.get_legend_handles_labels()
figure.legend(
    legend_handles,
    legend_labels,
    loc="upper center",
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.62, 1.01),
    ncol=3,
)
figure.supxlabel("Test MAE Skill Score")
figure.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 0.93))
plt.show()
```

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

stage_one_path = Path(
    "models/full/nn_grid_search/grid_search_v1_stage_1_validation_results.parquet"
)
if not stage_one_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing Stage-1 results: {stage_one_path}. "
        "Run the NN grid-search notebook before rendering the report."
    )

stage_one_results = pd.read_parquet(
    stage_one_path,
    columns=[
        "strategy",
        "positive_weight",
        "zero_to_positive_ratio",
    ],
)
stage_one_results.insert(
    0, "Model", [f"S1-{index}" for index in range(1, len(stage_one_results) + 1)]
)
stage_one_results["Strategy parameter"] = stage_one_results.apply(
    lambda row: (
        f"positive weight = {row['positive_weight']:g}"
        if pd.notna(row["positive_weight"])
        else (
            f"zero:positive = {row['zero_to_positive_ratio']:g}"
            if pd.notna(row["zero_to_positive_ratio"])
            else "--"
        )
    ),
    axis=1,
)
stage_one_results = (
    stage_one_results[
        [
            "Model",
            "strategy",
            "Strategy parameter",
        ]
    ]
    .rename(
        columns={
            "strategy": "Strategy",
        }
    )
)

def display_without_index(frame):
    """Render a compact Markdown table without pandas' index column."""
    def format_value(value):
        if pd.isna(value):
            return "--"
        return str(value).replace("|", "\\|")

    header = "| " + " | ".join(frame.columns) + " |"
    separator = "| " + " | ".join("---" for _ in frame.columns) + " |"
    rows = [
        "| " + " | ".join(format_value(value) for value in row) + " |"
        for row in frame.itertuples(index=False, name=None)
    ]
    display(Markdown("\n".join([header, separator, *rows])))


display_without_index(stage_one_results)
```

```{python}

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

winner_history_path = Path(
    "models/full/nn_grid_search/"
    "grid_search_v1_census_tracts_1h_"
    "s2_weighted_pw5_h128-64_lr0p001_training_history.parquet"
)
if not winner_history_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing winner training history: {winner_history_path}. "
        "Run the NN grid-search notebook before rendering the report."
    )

winner_history = pd.read_parquet(
    winner_history_path,
    columns=["epoch", "train_loss", "val_balanced_mae"],
).sort_values("epoch")
best_history_row = winner_history.loc[
    winner_history["val_balanced_mae"].idxmin()
]

figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.5))

axes[0].plot(
    winner_history["epoch"],
    winner_history["train_loss"],
    color="tab:blue",
)
axes[0].set(
    title="Training loss",
    xlabel="Epoch",
    ylabel="Weighted MSE",
)

axes[1].plot(
    winner_history["epoch"],
    winner_history["val_balanced_mae"],
    color="tab:orange",
)
axes[1].scatter(
    best_history_row["epoch"],
    best_history_row["val_balanced_mae"],
    color="black",
    zorder=3,
    label=f"Best epoch ({int(best_history_row['epoch'])})",
)
axes[1].set(
    title="Validation Balanced MAE",
    xlabel="Epoch",
    ylabel="Balanced MAE",
)
axes[1].legend()

for axis in axes:
    axis.grid(alpha=0.25)

figure.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
